description: Before/after comparison slider: two overlaid children with a draggable, keyboard-operable divider (side by side without JS)

attributes.name: position
attributes.description: Divider position 0-100 measured from the inline-start edge (right in RTL), default 50. Observed; user drags and key presses reflect the integer value back.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Accessible name for the slider handle, default "Comparison slider". Observed.

attributes.name: aria-label
attributes.description: Used as the slider handle's accessible name when label is absent

structure.description: Shown on the inline-start side of the divider (the "before" view)
Shown on the inline-end side of the divider (the "after" view). Further children are hidden once upgraded.

events.name: compare-surface:change
events.description: Fired when the user drags or uses the keyboard and the integer position changes. Not fired on upgrade or for attribute/property writes.

properties.name: position
properties.description: Get or set the integer position (0-100). Setting clamps, rounds and reflects to the attribute without firing compare-surface:change.
